subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Smart Cities and Total Monitoring
description: A fast breakdown of Smart Cities and Total Monitoring for builders.

hook.text: A city where sensors track traffic, air quality, pedestrian flow — and every person in real time.

buildup.text: Smart cities use IoT sensors to optimize infrastructure: streetlights, waste collection, transit.

discovery.text: Sidewalk Labs, a Google sibling, planned a smart neighborhood in Toronto with sensors on every block.

twist.text: Citizens protested. Who owns the data? Who watches the watchers? The project was cancelled.

climax.text: Smart cities promise efficiency. But without privacy rules, they deliver total surveillance.

quiz.question: Why was the Sidewalk Labs smart city project in Toronto cancelled?
options: Citizens protested over data privacy and surveillance concerns
Toronto already had a competing smart city
